verdict.rationale: Decagon's Simulations testing suite lets teams validate agent behavior across channels before deploying to production, and Duet can generate test cases covering diverse pathways. This is pre-production testing, but nothing describes an isolated sandbox environment or separation from production data and customer systems. Experiments explicitly run in production, so they do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented sandbox or staging environment, assurance that tests do not touch production data or live integrations, mock or test-data tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
